Subject: Quarterly readiness: exec briefing & per-account sales summaries

Team —

We need a concise packet for the exec QBR on Friday (06/19). Ask from leadership is simple: a one-page summary per named account called out below, plus a consolidated forecast roll-up and a separate slide showing any OKR risks tied to our Sales targets (Q2 to Q3 handoff). Please keep the one-pagers to a single page (metrics + top 3 risks + next 3 actions).

Priority accounts for the deck: Acme Corp (renewal, multi-product), ZenPay (expansion + security review), and two mid-market deals (SAT-271 & NOVA-3).

Deliverables and owners:
- Marissa: Acme one-pager + updated mutual action plan (MAP).
- Rishi: consolidated forecast table (by ARR bucket) and the OKR risk slide (highlight red/yellow accounts).
- Ben: two mid-market one-pagers + updated close-prob guidance.
- Tessa: QA pass + final slide layout for exec deck (templates attached).

Deadline: Wednesday 06/17 10:00 PT for drafts; final by Thursday 06/18 5:00 PT. If you foresee any blocker (security docs, procurement windows, legal redlines) note it inline and ping me.

Thanks — I want this to be short and usable in the readout.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
